turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're using this for a customer support IVR — how's that going?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Callers regularly compliment how natural the voice sounds, which honestly surprised us. Complaint volume about 'talking to a robot' dropped noticeably after we switched.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Any issues specific to the IVR use case?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Interruption handling is rough — if a caller talks over the agent, the audio doesn't stop cleanly, there's an awkward overlap for almost a second.
